text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What's going on, Tarumae? Anything
wrong?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Um, well... First, happy birthday,
Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Y-you see... I wanna make dinner for you

tonight... It's hokki meshi.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You told me once you wanted to try it!
So I went
and ordered some good surf
clams from my
hometown.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I'm not sure I'll do it
justice... or if
homemade cooking would
even count as a
present!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: No way! I'm sure it'll be really good!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hokki meshi, straight from the tourism

ambassador of Tomakomai? And you
must know
the best recipe there is since
you're great at
cooking!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, just thinking about it's making me
hungry!
Hehe, I can't wait to try it! ♪
